title: Panther Room with Harry James and Frank Sinatra
summary: In Chicago he shared a bill with James and Sinatra, urged Sinatra to go to California, and later felt he snubbed him at the Swanee Inn.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them
story.community_name: Working with Sinatra: bands, Vegas and the Sands

blocks.x: And then I...me an' Pete Johnson, Albert Ammons, Meade Lux Lewis...we got together an' we run in...we got a bookin' in Chicago at the Panther Room. In the Panther Room, they had Harry James' band and Frank Sinatra, so we worked with them for about a month.

Frank Sinatra and Harry James...Harry James had a date to come to California. Frank Sinatra didn't have none. He was goin' back to New York, so I talked him into comin' to California with Harry James. I tol' him to come on out...t'come...go to California...he might get in movin' pictures. So he had his wife an' his children...all his children in a hotel. They were just but kids then so they used to walk aroun' with 'im in the Panther Room. Long swords with sissabobs [shish kebob] with meat an' tomatoes, potatoes 'n' ever'thin' on a long sword.

So, I ordered me three or four o' them. Me an' Frank Sinatra an' the children an' then his wife, we ate up good. We had a good party in the dressing room, an' that's the last time I seen him for awhile... till he come to California and got in movin' pictures.
And then I went back to work at the Swanee Inn. Harry James an' his wife, Betty Davis...whatever her name was...not Betty Davis...

Betty Grable. She, uh...They came down there to see me. We had a good time. So he went back and told Frank. So, the next week, Frank Sinatra came down, an' I was so busy after them chicks out there an' I didn't have time to talk to Frank Sinatra too much, so he got angry and left. Fact, he just got fed up, so he left, and that the last time I seen him...outside o' in the movies.
You suppose he was upset because the chicks were payin' attention to you instead o' him?

No, no. No, I was after some chicks that worked there, an' I didn't sit down at the table and talk too much to 'im, so he was jus' a...'cause we was such good friends in Chicago. I guess he was just kinda disappointed with me 'cause I was takin' up too much time with these chicks. So, when I did get back to him, he had got up an' walked outa the place an' left. He was walkin' up LaBrea, so I came out an' hollered at him. He waved, and that's the last time I saw him...in all these years. But I see him in the movies an' every place.
